title: Minimum Operations to Make All Grid Elements Equal
description:
You are given a 2D integer array `grid` of size `m x n`, and an integer `k`.

In one operation, you can:

	Select any `k x k` **submatrix** of `grid`, and
	Increment **all elements** inside that **submatrix** by 1.

Return the **minimum** number of operations required to make all elements in the grid **equal**. If it is not possible, return -1.

A submatrix `(x1, y1, x2, y2)` is a matrix that forms by choosing all cells `matrix[x][y]` where `x1 <= x <= x2` and `y1 <= y <= y2`.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Minimum Operations to Make All Grid Elements Equal.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
